dialogues.speaker: Aranakula
dialogues.text: #Aranakula is keeping the Memory of Stone for Nara {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Aranakula
dialogues.text: #In this way, Nara {NICKNAME} will always recall, leaves of the Great Tree, breeze in the forest, and Aranakula, even after a long leave.

dialogues.speaker: Aranakula
dialogues.text: Nara Varuna will know about, the other Golden Nara, kept in the memories of Vana, when Nara Varuna comes back.
